say:1:1721513001:1.text: Well, well, look who's back—the Royal Guard's rising star! What's the hurry? Is she working on the Hall of Ancients case?
say:1:1721513001:1.source_cn: 哟，瞧瞧是谁回来了？咱们守备军的大明星啊。这么急匆匆的...

say:2:1721513002:1.text: She can't even if she wants to. Haven't you heard? The commander has barred her from the case.
say:2:1721513002:1.source_cn: 别傻了。没听说吗？司令下了命令，严禁某些人参与此案。

say:3:1721513003:1.text: Of course, the commander wouldn't let his beloved daughter handle such a dangerous case! What if she dirties that spotless armor of hers?
say:3:1721513003:1.source_cn: 这么危险的案子，司令大人怎么舍得让他那娇贵的女儿去冒险...

say:4:1721513004:1.text: She must be crushed to have missed her moment in the spotlight at the parade. Probably spent a week polishing that gleaming armor…
say:4:1721513004:1.source_cn: 真是遗憾。本来庆典上的军事献演可是某人的高光时刻。为了...

say:5:1721513005:1.text: And now, with everyone talking about the missing chapel, no one even remembers her.
say:5:1721513005:1.source_cn: 圣古堂没了，所有人的注意都被夺走了，这下没人记得她的英姿了。

say:8:1721513006:0.text: That's enough, Guyse and Hurron! Show some respect!
say:8:1721513006:0.source_cn: 盖伊、呼伦，住口！你们放尊重点——

say:10:1721513007:0.text: Wow, someone's already rushing to her defense. See? That's the privilege of coming from a prestigious family.
say:10:1721513007:0.source_cn: 噢——有人急了。看到了吗？这就是有个伟大家族的好处。

say:11:1721513008:0.text: She doesn't have to lift a finger. There are plenty of loyal lapdogs eager to bark on her behalf.
say:11:1721513008:0.source_cn: 根本不需要自己开口，只要站在那里，就会有忠诚的卫士跳出...

say:12:1721513009:1.text: If I were Commander Hendrik's son, I could land a captain's post without earning it.
say:12:1721513009:1.source_cn: 可不是嘛。如果我父亲是耀光之盾，哪怕我只会拿着木剑挥舞...

say:13:1721513010:1.text: Martin, is your name already on the promotion list? That would explain the brown-nosing.
say:13:1721513010:1.source_cn: 马丁，你这么卖力地表现，之后的晋升名单上肯定有你吧？

say:14:1721513011:0.text: You've gone too far! I challenge you to a duel! Whoever loses apologizes!
say:14:1721513011:0.source_cn: 你们，岂有此理！我要向你们发起决斗，谁输了谁道歉！

say:18:1721513013:0.text: Captain, they're badmouthing you and the commander! That's out of line!
say:18:1721513013:0.source_cn: 可是队长！这帮家伙……他们在侮辱您和司令的名誉！这绝对...

say:19:1721513014:0.text: We can't control what others think of us, but you must remember what your weapon stands for. It was forged to defend your homeland, not to be turned against your own.
say:19:1721513014:0.source_cn: 那是他们的舌头，但武器握在你手里。你的武器是为了守卫耀...

say:21:1721513016:1.text: Follow me. If they think we're riding on our family name, we'll prove them wrong with our skill. Double the slashing drills today.
say:21:1721513016:1.source_cn: 跟我来。既然有人觉得我们只是靠家族名声的花瓶，那就用实...

say:25:1721513018:1.text: Tsk... I can't stand her acting like she's better than everyone else.
